name: Burning Shadows
summary: In Skull Rock, the Eye of Burning Shadow carries warnings from the Burning Blade. Its voice threatens Gazz'uz with Neeru Fireblade's wrath.

sections.title: A Voice in the Stone
sections.body: After Gazz'uz falls deep within Skull Rock, the Eye of Burning Shadow is found among his remains. The stone carries a voice into the mind of anyone who holds it. The speaker demands a report from Gazz'uz. His secret work east of Orgrimmar has been compromised.

sections.title: A Curious Threat
sections.body: The voice gives Gazz'uz an ultimatum. Answer, or Neeru Fireblade will be told to hunt him down with swift brutality. Neeru lives openly in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, where he practices dark arts under Thrall's strict oversight. When the pendant reaches him, the warlock feigns surprise and wonders why the cult used his name to frighten Gazz'uz.

faq.q: What is the Eye of Burning Shadow?
faq.answer: The Eye of Burning Shadow is an enchanted pendant found among the Burning Blade leader Gazz'uz's remains inside Skull Rock. It carries two-way telepathic messages between cult operatives and their unseen masters.

faq.q: Who is speaking through the pendant?
faq.answer: An unidentified superior in the Shadow Council or Burning Blade hierarchy is trying to contact Gazz'uz, unaware he has already been slain in Skull Rock.

faq.q: Why does the voice threaten Gazz'uz with Neeru Fireblade?
faq.answer: The voice says Neeru Fireblade will come after Gazz'uz with brutal force if he fails to report. Neeru says he is known for hunting the Warchief's enemies, though he finds it strange that the voice singled him out.

faq.q: Where do I take the Eye of Burning Shadow?
aliases: where to turn in burning shadows
faq.answer: Take the pendant to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, where he hovers over cauldrons and tomes.

faq.q: How does Neeru Fireblade react when given the eye?
faq.answer: Neeru is intrigued that the voice singled out his name, and finds it stranger still that the Burning Blade cultists bear a name so close to his own. He keeps the pendant to study it and ponder its message.
Gazz'uz lurks at the deepest point of Skull Rock, a cavern hidden among the crags on Durotar's eastern coastline, just east of Orgrimmar.

angles.text: As a warlock training in the Cleft of Shadow, you hear the Burning Blade invoke another practitioner's name. The threat shows how thin the line is between state-sanctioned fel study and open treason.
As a member of the Horde, you uncover whispers between cultists just outside the capital's gates. The demonic corruption of the Old Horde still festers uncomfortably close to Durotar's heart.
As an orc, you know the Burning Blade's presence in Durotar desecrates your new homeland. Orcs fought alongside Thrall to purge the Legion's taint.
